# equinix_fabric_asn (Data Source)

Fabric V4 API compatible data resource that allows users to fetch an Autonomous System Number (ASN) by UUID.

Additional Documentation:
* API: https://docs.equinix.com/api-catalog/fabricv4/#tag/ASNs



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asn_id` (String) The UUID of the ASN this data source should retrieve

### Read-Only

- `assets` (Attributes List) Assets (services) the ASN is attached to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assets))
- `change` (Attributes) Current state of the latest change on the ASN (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change))
- `change_log` (Attributes) Details of the last change on the ASN (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change_log))
- `href` (String) Equinix auto generated URI to the ASN
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource
- `location` (Attributes) Location of the ASN (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `number` (Number) Autonomous System Number
- `ownership_challenge_details` (Attributes) Details of the ASN ownership challenge (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ownership_challenge_details))
- `project` (Attributes) Project the ASN belongs to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--project))
- `range` (String) Range of the ASN. One of: 16_BIT, 32_BIT
- `rir_region` (String) Regional Internet Registry region of the ASN. One of: AFRINIC, APNIC, ARIN, LACNIC, RIPE_NCC
- `state` (String) State of the ASN. One of: REQUESTED, PROVISIONING, PENDING, PROVISIONED, ATTACHED, FAILED, PROVISIONING_FAILED, DEPROVISIONING, DEPROVISIONING_FAILED, DEPROVISIONED
- `uuid` (String) Equinix-assigned unique identifier for the ASN record

<a id="nestedatt--assets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assets`

Read-Only:

- `announcing_metro` (String) Metro announcing the ASN
- `ip_blocks` (Attributes List) IP blocks announced with the ASN (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assets--ip_blocks))
- `service` (Attributes) Service the ASN is attached to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assets--service))
- `uuid` (String) Asset identifier

<a id="nestedatt--assets--ip_blocks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assets.ip_blocks`

Read-Only:

- `href` (String) URI to the IP block
- `type` (String) IP block reference type. One of: IPV4_IP_BLOCK, IPV6_IP_BLOCK
- `uuid` (String) IP block identifier


<a id="nestedatt--assets--service"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assets.service`

Read-Only:

- `href` (String) URI to the service
- `type` (String) Service type. One of: IA
- `uuid` (String) Service identifier



<a id="nestedatt--change"></a>
### Nested Schema for `change`

Read-Only:

- `href` (String) URI to the change resource


<a id="nestedatt--change_log"></a>
### Nested Schema for `change_log`

Read-Only:

- `created_date_time` (String) Creation date and time
- `deleted_date_time` (String) Deletion date and time
- `updated_date_time` (String) Last update date and time

- `metro_name` (String) Metro name
- `region` (String) Region of the metro

### Nested Schema for `ownership_challenge_details`
